name: right-code-imagegen
description: Generate and edit images through Right Code's asynchronous API from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images through Right Code
interface.longDescription: A standalone Right Code image-generation and editing plugin for Codex. It submits asynchronous image tasks, supports reference images and sequential multi-image requests, preserves task checkpoints, resumes interrupted polling, and saves original results locally.
defaultPrompt: Use Right Code to generate an image and save the original result.
Use Right Code to edit the attached reference image.
Resume an interrupted Right Code task from its task ID.
